remediatedFormulation.strainKinematics: eps = B * u (evaluated from tetrahedral Jacobian J and shape function derivatives)
remediatedFormulation.constitutiveLaw: 3D Hookean isotropic elasticity sigma = lambda * tr(eps) * I + 2 * mu * eps
remediatedFormulation.equivalentStress: von Mises equivalent stress sigma_vm = sqrt(0.5 * [(s11-s22)^2 + (s22-s33)^2 + (s33-s11)^2 + 6*(s12^2 + s23^2 + s13^2)])
remediatedFormulation.nodalAveraging: Area/volume weighted tensor accumulation across incident tetrahedral elements
